notes: ESTIMATED. Activity index is mean top-1% AIA 94A pixel intensity from one forward pass on Oct 2014 benchmark data, normalized to ~Oct 2014 reference level. This is a scalar proxy for near-term flare-associated EUV activity, not a calibrated X-ray flux value. Source: Roy et al. 2025 Surya-1.0, NASA SDO bench, AIA 94A channel. REPORTED ALONGSIDE the NOAA predicted-flux envelope for context; no code applies this index to the envelope or to the deorbit compliance verdict, which computes from the frozen NRLMSISE-00 decay table.
